verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 44.6
verses.english: Linked Discourses 44.6

verses.pali: 1. Abyākatavagga
verses.english: 1. The Undeclared Points

verses.pali: Catutthasāriputtakoṭṭhikasutta
verses.english: With Sāriputta and Koṭṭhita (4th)

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ca sāriputto, āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṁ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Sāriputta and Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita were staying near Varanasi, in the deer park at Isipatana.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākoṭṭhikena saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then in the late afternoon, Venerable Sāriputta came out of retreat, went to Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita, and they greeted each other.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṁ mahākoṭṭhikaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to Mahākoṭṭhita:

verses.pali: “‘kiṁ nu kho, āvuso koṭṭhika, hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’ti …pe…
verses.english: “Reverend Koṭṭhita, does a realized one still exist after death?” …

verses.pali: ‘kiṁ panāvuso, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’ti iti puṭṭho samāno:
verses.english: “Reverend, when asked these questions, you say that this has not been declared by the Buddha.

verses.pali: ‘etampi kho, āvuso, abyākataṁ bhagavatā—
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’ti vadesi.
Ko nu kho, āvuso, hetu, ko paccayo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: What’s the cause, what’s the reason why this has not been declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Rūpārāmassa kho, āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: “Reverend, if you like, love, and enjoy form, and don’t truly see the cessation of form, you think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: ‘A realized one no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: ‘a realized one both still exists and no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Vedanārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you like, love, and enjoy feeling …

verses.pali: saññārāmassa kho, āvuso …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: saṅkhārārāmassa kho āvuso …pe…
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: viññāṇārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: consciousness, and don’t truly see the cessation of consciousness, you think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Na rūpārāmassa kho, āvuso, na rūparatassa na rūpasammuditassa, rūpanirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you don’t like, love, and enjoy form …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
Na vedanārāmassa kho, āvuso …pe…
verses.english: feeling …

verses.pali: na saññārāmassa kho, āvuso …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: na saṅkhārārāmassa kho, āvuso …pe…
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: na viññāṇārāmassa kho, āvuso, na viññāṇaratassa na viññāṇasammuditassa, viññāṇanirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: consciousness, and you truly see the cessation of consciousness, you don’t think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, āvuso, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why this has not been declared by the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: “But reverend, could there be another way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Siyā, āvuso.
verses.english: “There could, reverend.

verses.pali: Bhavārāmassa kho, āvuso, bhavaratassa bhavasammuditassa, bhavanirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you like, love, and enjoy existence, and don’t truly see the cessation of continued existence, you think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Na bhavārāmassa kho, āvuso, na bhavaratassa na bhavasammuditassa, bhavanirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you don’t like, love, and enjoy existence, and you truly see the cessation of continued existence, you don’t think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This too is a way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: “But reverend, could there be another way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Siyā, āvuso.
verses.english: “There could, reverend.

verses.pali: Upādānārāmassa kho, āvuso, upādānaratassa upādānasammuditassa, upādānanirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you like, love, and enjoy grasping, and don’t truly see the cessation of grasping, you think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Na upādānārāmassa kho, āvuso, na upādānaratassa na upādānasammuditassa, upādānanirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you don’t like, love, and enjoy grasping, and you truly see the cessation of grasping, you don’t think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva, hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This too is a way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: “But reverend, could there be another way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Siyā, āvuso.
verses.english: “There could, reverend.

verses.pali: Taṇhārāmassa kho, āvuso, taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you like, love, and enjoy craving, and don’t truly see the cessation of craving, you think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Na taṇhārāmassa kho, āvuso, na taṇhāratassa na taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: If you don’t like, love, and enjoy craving, and you truly see the cessation of craving, you don’t think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This too is a way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: “But reverend, could there be another way of explaining why this was not declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Ettha dāni, āvuso sāriputta, ito uttari kiṁ icchasi?
verses.english: “Seriously, reverend, what more could you want?

verses.pali: Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttassa, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhuno vaṭṭaṁ natthi paññāpanāyā”ti.
verses.english: For one who is freed due to the ending of craving, there is no cycle of rebirths to be found.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
